summary.html: Block Cuts 40% of Workforce: Jack Dorsey's company lays off 4,000 employees following successful integration of internal AI agent Goose, explicitly citing AI productivity gains.
Anthropic Rejects Pentagon: Dario Amodei turns down a $200M contract, enforcing Claude's safeguards and refusing unrestricted use for national security systems.
OpenClaw Ecosystem Booms: The OpenClaw repo surpasses Linux in GitHub stars, while launching new features like ACP thread-bound agents, external secrets management, and OpenClaw-RL.
Gold Surges & Economy: Gold reclaims $5,250/oz amid continued uncertainty, while analysts fact-check Trump's claims of $18 trillion in new foreign investments.

items.title: Anish Moonka: Block's AI Layoffs
items.body: Block laid off 4,000 people (40% of workforce) after deploying an internal AI agent called Goose, which reportedly saves employees 8-10 hours a week.

items.title: The Kobeissi Letter: Anthropic vs. Pentagon
items.body: Anthropic rejected US Defense Secretary's 'final offer' for a $200M contract, refusing to allow their platform to be used for mass surveillance and autonomous weapons.

items.title: JUMPERZ: OpenClaw Update
items.body: OpenClaw shipped major updates including ACP thread-bound agents, external secrets management, and a new agent routing CLI for easier swarm management.

items.title: Ling Yang: OpenClaw-RL
items.body: Introduced OpenClaw-RL, a fully async reinforcement learning framework that allows local AI agents to continuously learn from user preferences and conversational feedback.

items.title: Bo Wang: DeepSeek DualPath
items.body: DeepSeek published a paper on DualPath, fixing the KV-Cache storage bandwidth bottleneck and nearly doubling throughput for multi-turn agentic inference using RDMA.

items.title: John McBride: stereOS
items.body: Introduced stereOS: a NixOS-based operating system hardened and purpose-built for AI agents with gVisor sub-virtualization for secure sandboxing.

items.title: ℏεsam: OpenClaw Stars
items.body: The OpenClaw repository has now surpassed Linux in GitHub stars.

items.title: Watcher.Guru: Gold Reclaims $5,250
items.body: Gold has reclaimed the $5,250 mark, driven by continued uncertainty and on-again, off-again tariffs.

items.title: Alan Reynolds: Fact-Checking the $18 Trillion Claim
items.body: Analysis reveals President Trump's claim of $18 trillion in new investments is largely exaggerated, with actual verifiable pledges closer to $5-9.7 trillion.

items.title: Imran Lakha: S&P 500 Volatility
items.body: While the S&P 500 realized volatility is at 11, the options market is pricing in maximum fear, signaling that market makers are anticipating a major risk-clearing event.

items.title: Aakash Gupta: Anthropic's Strategy
items.body: Anthropic's entire competitive moat relies on 'worrying out loud'—growing 14x annually while raising $30B by marketing fear as a responsible feature.

items.title: Balaji: The First AI Cut
items.body: Jack Dorsey's 40% headcount reduction at Block sends shockwaves through tech: adapt to AI agentic workflows or get disrupted.

items.title: Taelin: AI 24/7 Experiment
items.body: Leaving an AI to code 24/7 hit hard walls: results exploded in complexity and expense, proving AI is currently better at building known things rather than creating truly new concepts.
